avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may decrease canagliflozin plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Herbal diuretics (Juniper, Buchu)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive diuretic effect increases dehydration and acute kidney injury risk with SGLT2 inhibitor
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; monitor renal function if unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; adjust canagliflozin dose if needed

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and glucose lowering
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; educate patient on symptoms

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium increases dehydration risk and may worsen volume depletion from SGLT2 inhibition
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on low-sodium diet; maintain adequate hydration

caution_foods.name: High-calorie/high-carbohydrate meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Large glucose loads may overcome canagliflozin's glucose-lowering capacity
caution_foods.action: Reinforce balanced meal planning with healthcare provider

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase canagliflozin exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit juice consumption; monitor for adverse effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function (eGFR, urinalysis) regularly due to SGLT2 inhibitor effects on kidney hemodynamics and increased genital infection risk. Ensure adequate hydration status and educate on signs of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) and acute kidney injury.
